notes: Held-out tasks (round 2), written after v0.2's tuning and before any kopt measurement on them; not derived from bench/results/failures.md. Gold read in the code with git grep and sed only. Re-check with `kopt bench bench/tasks-heldout/webpack.json --verify`.

tasks.question: Where does webpack decide that a module request is ignored when both resourceRegExp and contextRegExp are configured?
tasks.search: ignore plugin resourceRegExp contextRegExp request ignored
tasks.verifiedBy: Read lib/IgnorePlugin.js: checkIgnore tests resourceRegExp against the request and, when given, contextRegExp against the context; both must match.

tasks.question: How does the BannerPlugin turn the banner text into a comment at the top of the emitted files?
tasks.search: banner plugin comment top of emitted files
tasks.verifiedBy: Read lib/BannerPlugin.js: the constructor turns the banner option into a function that wraps the text with wrapComment unless options.raw; apply() then adds it to the matching assets.
